summary: How an element bot picks its next move (NpcBending; Tidebreak, the ring sport: the owner, 2026-10-04, the bots cast the same moves as the player). Every (move, mode) of its element's kit (round 2's skills: Bending.keys' 1-5, its guard on E and its jab: moves.json guards, jabs) is an option; each is scored every think by its role (offence, control, defence, mobility, reaction, sustain, setup), the element's personality, its range band and its 'when' (the need it answers), then a little chance (the bot's own seeded rng). Lock times are the player's own (SwayCaster's rule: the move's lock_s or mode_lock_s x the expert tier's mastery.lock_mult x the preset's lock_mult; a move's ai_factor only on easy and normal). Every number here is tuned by eye and by the soak (tests/ring/test_ring_soak.gd).

_doc.defaults: By the spec's do (the move's mode in data/sway/moves.json): role, range_m [near, far] (a number past 1 is metres; 'spec' takes the spec's own range_m or radius_m), cool_s (how long before it picks the same option again). An unknown do is treated as 'bolt'.
_doc.zones: A zone's role by its kind (spec.zone): the guards answer what flies at it (answers: attack kinds, or a threat's own name: air_spear, the Air Lance, an air bolt of shape spear, which water's Turn takes and sends back as ice), the barriers are defence, the ground and the moving ones control.
_doc.moves: Per move, then per mode: what overrides the defaults (role, range_m, when, answers, cool_s, weight, grow (the chance a spec that grows is held to grow), way (a dash whose way is the keys held: 'side', 'back', 'forward'), combo {after: 'move/mode', bonus}). when: hurt (struck within hurt_s, or under half health), close (the foe within close_m), far (past far_m), stone_near, own_wall, own_damaged_wall, near_pool, foe_airborne, foe_grounded, foe_up_or_walled (in the air, or a wall on the line between: the High Kick's arc clears it), holding (a caught stone held), room_back, edge_behind, airborne, foe_far. answers on an option of any role makes it a guard too (NpcBending.is_guard: begun against a threat of those kinds as a reaction is), with min_knock (the threat's knock_mps at least this) and guard_when; a dash only with room for it. Threat kinds past the attacks': held (a stone held up and aimed at it), vortex (a tornado), floor (a Boulder rolling along the deck: jumped), under (a Column or a Geyser being cast at it: stepped off by a dash). A wave along the deck (the Kick's floor wave) is its element's kind for the guards and jumped as well (jump_*). Round 2: the moves the kits cut are gone from here.
_doc.old: The Sway's old spells (no bend spec: stone_form spike and cannonball, earth_wall wall, pillar self, mend): BendCast.cast casts them when it is there; without it only spike and wall are cast (NpcBending's own fallbacks).
_doc.elements: Each element's personality: a multiplier per role (and 'knock' for options whose knock_mps is 8 or more), react (x the preset's react_chance: how often a threat is answered at all; one roll a volley: NpcBending.VOLLEY_S), grow (the chance a move that grows is held to grow) and the range band it keeps between casts (keep_m).
_doc.presets: The difficulty: reaction_s (from a threat seen to its answer begun), guard_reaction_s (the same for its own guard on E: a reflex on his wind-up, so even an easy bot guards some shots; KITS round 2), scatter_deg (one sigma of the aim's line), lead (the share of a moving foe's lead taken), lock_mult (x the player's lock), ai_factor (the move's ai_factor applied: easy and normal only), react_chance (a threat answered at all), perfect_chance (an answered threat met on the beat: in the guard's first guard_rules.perfect_s; else late, half through; round 2, spec 8.1: easy 0.1, normal 0.3, hard 0.6), jump_chance (a wave along the deck jumped), lightning_dash (a dash on a lightning's flash), rest_s (between one release and the next lock), think_s, grace_s (the opening: no attack or control begun and nothing that knocks; guards and footwork only).
_doc.jump: The floor rule (spec 2.8: along the floor? jump): jump_mps the bot's jump (m/s up at its gravity 18: its feet over 0.6 m from about 0.1 s to 0.6 s after), jump_lead_s the takeoff that long before the wave reaches its feet.

_guard_cool_s: after any guard begun (a reaction: catch, deflect, shield, spin, redirect...), no other guard for this long past its lock (s): one guard after another of whatever kind turtles (the soak, 2026-10-05: an air bot answered every fire bolt with return, spin and shield in turn)

pct._doc: Round 3, the % ring (smash_r3 spec §9; NpcRingMind, only while RingRules.stock_on()): the bot moves only by its pad (NpcPad, the player's own intent), picks a state each tick from what both bodies show (NEUTRAL, PRESSURE, EDGEGUARD, LEDGETRAP, REELING, RECOVER, LEDGE, RESPAWN; held state_hold_s unless a hit lands), and runs round 2's chooser only in NEUTRAL and PRESSURE. Every number by preset below; the shared ones here. It reads only %, lives, positions, poses and visible wind-ups, never inputs; reaction_s stays the preset's.
pct._ko: the KO read (RingPredict through the rules' own launch): a killing option x ko_bonus; normal needs ko_margin_m more (the foe read that much further in), hard the foe's best steering (di_deg each way); x far_finisher_mult when cast from past far_finisher_m (it walks in to finish); below build_pct x build_mult on the options with the best % per lock second (the top build_top of them); hard keeps a finisher fresh (x fresh_mult on a KO move staled fresh_stale_n or more times while the foe is under fresh_below_pct); the up-launchers (uplaunch) never get the KO bonus
pct._keep_m: round 4: the range band each element keeps in NEUTRAL in the % ring (NpcRingMind.keep_band), over round 2's elements.keep_m (the duel and the open world keep theirs): nearer, so strings come true and the air play reaches; October 2026 verification: Fire keeps 2-6 m for its close-range Ember volley and kit, with player damage and spread unchanged
pct._ko_fresh_k: round 4: a killing option x 1 / (1 + ko_fresh_k x its stale count): the finishers spread (the soak's top finisher <= 0.5)
pct._guard_kinds: round 5 (R5-BALANCE): in the % ring every guard stops every attack (spec v2 §2.5: perfect nothing, late half as a slide; its own kinds still sent back as round 2's), so the bot's guard on E answers each of these threat kinds, not only its element's zones.*.answers ('under': a Column or a Geyser being cast at it, met on the beat as the player meets it with E). Lightning stays fire's (only a Parry on the beat sends it back); 'held' and 'vortex' keep round 2's answers. Round 4's soak: a guard of its own kinds only left earth open to every fire, water and air shot, fire to every Lash, Wave and Geyser, and water's Turn alone met fire's shots: water won 0.83 of its games, fire 0.29.
pct._held_shove: round 5: a stone its Catch holds is thrown back with E (the return: x1.2, faster each rally) or, at this chance, with Shove (key 2: 'Shove throws the stone you hold'), as a player mixes them; the catch itself and the return are untouched. Round 4's earth mirror was 0.34 of each side's casts on E (each catch and each return a cast of it).
pct._strings: true strings (spec §6.6, §6.9; lead_combos.out v2): after `lead` lands, `next` begins only while RingRules.hitstun_left(foe) >= its lock + its flight - 1/60 (hitstun_left counts the 0.6 s escape). lead 'jab' is the element's jab; 'pop' the jab string's third hit (the Pop); next 'guard' is E (earth: the Pop's stone, or a caught stone, thrown). holding: only with a stone in hand. read: a read, not a string (it ends one at read_end's chance). Never the same move twice in a row, jabs aside (the step and the Pop are the jab string). Round 4: lead 'air_hit' the air close hit, 'slam' the Slam; lead '*' any lead but the jab; next 'air_hit' a jump at him then the air close hit (only from pct.air.air_follow_m, weighted by the preset's air_follow); of the true follow-ups one by its weight w (1 by default; a stone in hand first). jab_step_s mirrors AIR's jab step (spec §6.4: the next jab ready that long after the last left the hand once it hit); AIR's moves.json jab_step_s rules when present.
pct._victim: steering (di [chance, right way]) is set once at the launch through pad.di and read by the rules at 0.1 s; at its own % of survive_pct or more it keeps, of -di_deg, 0 and +di_deg, the one with the longest way to the water (RingPredict.flight), below that it steers across the hitter's line (away from the follow-up); the wrong way is the other side. break_out: the chance it presses jump (a fresh press, never a buffered one) the frame RingRules.can_escape says it may; tech: the chance it presses E tech_lead_s before it meets the deck while tumbling (a direction with it half the time). Above high_pct of its own: reaction_s + high_react_s and it keeps centre_pull x centre_pull_m further from its end.
pct._recover: off the deck and free: RingMoves.simulate over the six plans (1 drift, 2 a late double jump, 3 double jump now, 4 double jump then the Rise at the edge, 5 the same aimed aim_high_m over the lip, 6 an air dodge toward the lip first) toward the nearest open lip, every recover_replan_s; the first in its order that reaches the grab box or the deck runs (none: the desperate line, everything toward the lip). order 45: 4 or 5 mixed by high_share. err_deg: the Rise's aim error; late_s: the margin taken off a late double jump's latest moment; dodge: never | near (a foe within dodge_near_m) | threat (to slip a seen threat). Never a 4th grab without the deck (grab_limit).
pct._edge: on the edge (LEDGE): easy climbs after its after_s; normal picks climb, jump, roll, attack by weights after a wait in wait_s; hard reads the foe: within ledge_near_m a roll (when it lands behind him) or the attack, within ledge_mid_m a jump, farther a climb at once. Every bot acts before its first-grab safety ends (act_margin_s) and before hang_s. Hard counts the player's edge options and covers his favourite (LEDGETRAP).
pct._keep_off: keeping him off (EDGEGUARD, the foe off the deck): it shoots from inside_m or more inside the lip at the predicted landing point; hard waits wait_back_m from the lip with a lock filled, released as the foe's first-grab safety runs out (RingMoves.ledge_safe_left), listens for the Rise's tell, and chases off the deck only if its own plan from the intercept point succeeds with a jump fewer and the foe is at chase_min_pct or more. Never a hit into a safety (RingRules.safe_until, RingMoves.intangible). No wall within wall_lip_m of a lip while the foe is off the deck. Round 4: its shots weighed by their knock and the chooser's repeat rule x keep_off_repeat (each cast of the move so far: 1 + repeat_k x n x keep_off_repeat).
pct._heal: Patch (heal.move) only with RingRules.fresh_pct >= min_fresh, standing still (under still_mps), the foe min_dist_m or more away and not winding up at it, and only when RingRules.heal_allowed (never while the foe is out)
pct._casting: the bot's casts under the player's round-3 rules (AIR's numbers mirrored until AIR's data has them): key 3 on the deck goes no sooner than key3_min_s after its press; in the air 3 is the air dodge (pad dodge), keys 4 and 5 wait for the deck, and a key-2 first move started in the air is the Slam and the jab the air close hit (round 4: NpcRingMind.air_form; landing first calls the Slam off and turns the air hit back into the jab). A lock held full waiting for a safety to end (never a hit into one) is let go after hold_max_s. The lock waits (frozen) while the bot is in hitstun; lightning's charge still breaks.
pct._standin: THE STAND-IN MOVER (NpcRingMind.standin_step / standin_sim): the recovery planner's look-ahead and the tests' mover until MOVE's RingMoves.simulate and RingMoves.pre land (spec §4-§5's numbers mirrored: one gravity, the jump, the double jump keeping half the carry, the drift, the air dodge, each element's Rise, the grab box, three grabs then the deck, the water and the curtain). Never read once RingMoves.simulate answers.
pct._air: round 4 (BOTS2): the hop (NEUTRAL, PRESSURE, ready to attack, hop_room_m or more of deck along the way): from air_hit_hop_m the air close hit (the jab's air form, LMB in the air), from slam_hop_m the Slam (key 2's first move begun in the air) on a man on the deck, else a key-1 move whose lock is hop_lock_max_s or less let go in the air (drift hop_cast_share of the run); its drift turned back toward the middle once the way it drifts has less than hop_room_min_m of deck left; the air close hit let go once his chest will be within its reach (reach_m + reach_radius_share x radius_m, closing at close_mps over its lock); a double jump at the top (vy <= double_vy) first at a man in the air; over after hop_s. The string table's 'air_hit' (a jump at him, then the air close hit) only from air_follow_m. The Slam over the lip: a man slam_under_m..slam_depth_m under the lip and out to slam_out_m, no safety on him within slam_safe_s; it stands slam_spot_in_m inside the lip over him (within slam_spot_tol_m), hops drifting slam_out_share outward, only when its own way back from slam_back_m past the lip and slam_back_up_m over it comes back with a jump spent. The shield: its guard raised to stand shield_lead_s before a held Lightning or a shot of shield_knock_mps and up, held until the threat is gone and shield_linger_s past its strike (guard.hold_max_s at most); then the punish window (the preset's punish_s): offence with a lock of punish_lock_max_s or less x punish_mult. Each preset's chances in its 'air' (per think, ready to attack and in range: air_hit, slam, hop_cast; double; air_follow (the weight of the air follow-ups, 0: none); slam_edge (once a time he is off); shield (once a threat)).
